conjecture: FP_x^2 = FV * FP_y  (i.e. FV : FP_x = FP_x : FP_y, FP_x is the mean proportional between FV and FP_y)
reason: F is the antipode of G, so j (through F parallel to the tangent f at G) is the tangent to c at F. The chord GE is the polar of C; its meet D with j satisfies FD = 2*FV along j (numerically FD = 4.619, FV = 2.309), so e (perpendicular to j at D) and h1 (perpendicular to j at V) are parallel lines with h1 midway between F and e. Hence h1 is the vertex tangent, V the principal vertex, j the axis, F the focus and e the directrix of a parabola. For a generic P_x on h1, the ray FP_x meets e at K with FK = 2*FP_x, so K is the reflection of F in m (m is perpendicular to FP_x at P_x). The point P_y on m with P_yK parallel to the axis j therefore has P_yF = P_yK = dist(P_y, e), so P_y lies on that parabola and m is its tangent at P_y, with P_x the foot of the perpendicular from the focus on the tangent. Newton's Lemma XIV (triangle FVP_x right-angled at V and similar to triangle FP_xP_y) then gives FP_y : FP_x = FP_x : FV, i.e. FP_x^2 = FV*FP_y. Check with the given coordinates: FP_x^2 = 26.20, FV*FP_y = 2.309*11.345 = 26.20.

conjecture: FP_x^2 = FV * FP_y  (i.e. FV : FP_x = FP_x : FP_y, so FP_x is the mean proportional between FV and FP_y)
reason: j is the tangent to c at F (F is antipodal to G, so j, parallel to the tangent f at G, is the tangent at F) and plays the role of the axis of a parabola with focus F; h1 is perpendicular to j at V, and D (where the polar chord GE meets j) satisfies FV = VD numerically (FV ≈ 2.309, FD ≈ 4.619), so e, perpendicular to j at D, is the directrix and V the vertex of that parabola. P_x on the vertex tangent h1 with m ⟂ FP_x at P_x makes m a tangent of the parabola, and the line through K (on the directrix) parallel to the axis meets m at the point of contact P_y, so P_y lies on the parabola (P_yF = P_yK). The triangle FVP_x is right-angled at V and the triangle FP_xP_y is right-angled at P_x, and they share the angle at F, so they are similar: FV/FP_x = FP_x/FP_y. This is exactly Newton's Lemma XIV (S=F, A=V, N=P_x, P=P_y). Numerically FP_x^2 ≈ 26.20 and FV·FP_y ≈ 2.309 × 11.345 ≈ 26.20, and it holds for every generic P_x on h1.
